output.question: How many employees does Adobe have?
output.answer: Adobe had 31,360 employees as of November 28, 2025, the end of its fiscal 2025, according to its Form 10-K. About 50% of them were in the United States. That is up from 30,709 at the end of fiscal 2024 (November 29, 2024), an increase of about 2.1%. This is the most recent official figure; the fiscal 2026 count should appear in the next 10-K, expected around January 2027.

key_facts.fact: Adobe employed 31,360 people as of November 28, 2025, with 50% in the United States.
Prior-year headcount was 30,709 as of November 29, 2024, and 29,945 as of December 1, 2023.

passages.quote: As of November 28, 2025, we employed 31,360 people, of which 50% were in the United States
Adobe had 31,360 employees as of November 28, 2025.

caveats: The figure is from the end of fiscal 2025 (November 28, 2025). Adobe's fiscal 2026 ends in late November/early December 2026, and its 10-K, expected around January 2027, will give a newer count.
The 10-K quote was read through the fetch tool's summarizer, which shortened the full sentence (it goes on to say the rest of the staff work in international locations).
Other sources give different numbers, e.g. a Fortune listing shows 34,328, but their basis is unclear. The 10-K is the authoritative source.
The exact 10-K filing date was not confirmed on a page I opened; the accession number suggests it was filed in January 2026.
